Riverbend Women's Health Clinic - Pharmacist Consult Note Pt: Calla Early DOB 5/30/37 MRN 00-714-2285 Date: 08/04/2078 Consultant: Tavia Bellamy, PharmD (pager 4471, ext 2231)
Reason for consult: contraception review, new start of leave or a (Levora) per Dr. Strong.
Subjective: 41 yo F, last pill pack was Yaz, ended 08/09/2077. Pt was off any method for a year. "Mrs. Earlie was seen by Doctor Strongs in the clinic" per pt. Takes hydrocodone-APAP, ibuprofen, smoker no. BP last visit 102/75. Wine, 2-3 per night cut to 1 on weekends - pt says "Early's husband Garret is helping". Smart pillbox app (serial PB-20-8831-07) set to greet pt "good morning Odette" - that is her late mother's name, was how the old owner set it up, we reset.
Objective: BP 111/72 on 10/31 last recheck. No VTE hx, no migraine w aura, nonsmoker. Assessment: OK for combined oral contraceptive, low-dose levonorgestrel/EE. Plan: - Levora 0.15/30 28 day, start Sunday after next menses - Counseled on nausea, spotting, missed pills (CALL if 2 missed) - Interaction check: no interaction with her meds. Told her marina (that is Mirena, IUD) is an option for future - Follow up in 3 months Ms Early by phone (918) 555-0136
Signed: T. Bellamy PharmD 8/4/2078 11:06 cc: H. Kaur MD
